request.initial_prompt: "A fig for Rizzio!" cried she, tossing her head with all its curls, as she moved to the piano. "It is my opinion the fiddler David must have been an insipid sort of fellow; I like black Bothwell better: to my mind a man is nothing without a spice of the devil in him; and history may say what it will of James Hepburn, but I have a notion, he was just the sort of wild, fierce, bandit hero whom I could have consented to gift with my hand."
request.hotwords: Rizzio, David, I, Bothwell, James, Hepburn

raw_segments.text: A fig for Rizzio! cried she, tossing her head with all its curls, as she moved to the piano.
It is my opinion the fiddler David must have been an insipid sort of fellow.
I like black Bothwell better. To my mind a man is nothing without a spice of the devil in him,
and history may say what it will of James Hepburn, but I have a notion,
he was just the sort of wild, fierce, bandit hero whom I could have consented to gift with my hand.
